MATE RULE: In each column, 1 <-> 2, 3 <-> 4, 5 <-> 6, and so on.

EXPLICIT MATRICES BELOW: The 23 finite UOMs used in Theorem 34, grouped by the number of columns, then listed by increasing row count.
